title: This AI Takes Apart Any App
description:
This AI tool takes apart any app to show you how it works: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) gives your AI agent the assembly, pseudocode, strings and symbols of a program, no source code needed. Free, open source (MIT), runs on your machine. 25,784 GitHub stars in one day.

Full breakdown: https://youtu.be/6ZxAIGAm9Qo
Source: https://github.com/morluto/rea
Only take apart software you're allowed to. AI voice (Chatterbox), AI music. Drawn and animated in code. Not affiliated with REA.

#ReverseEngineering #AI #Shorts
